name: rarus-echo-transcription
description: Operate the RARUS Echo transcription CLI from agent sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Use the RARUS Echo CLI for queue, submit, status, and transcript workflows.
interface.longDescription: A skills-only plugin that teaches agents to operate the existing RARUS Echo CLI safely through Docker or an installed local Composer binary.
defaultPrompt: Use RARUS Echo Transcription to inspect the current transcription queue.
Use RARUS Echo Transcription to submit a local audio file with diarization and fetch the transcript.
